case: Domain-over-enum metadata and parameters under a shadowed search_path
change: Add a same-named domain and leaf enum in two schemas; resolve the target schema metadata and test structured equality plus direct text and SQL NULL comparisons under a shadowed search_path.
contract: Catalog metadata for the target domain-over-enum column identifies the target schema's qualified leaf enum even while search_path resolves same-named types in a shadow schema.
A structured equality filter selects the matching target-schema row and preserves the target domain column type.
A direct text equality comparison and IS NOT DISTINCT FROM with SQL NULL succeed against the target table after transaction-local SET LOCAL search_path selects the shadow schema.
The shadow table retains its original domain values and sibling data.
independent_oracle: PostgreSQL current_schema(), driver catalog metadata, pg_typeof(status)::text, and exact target/shadow row values after native parameter comparisons.

remaining: This case covers one same-named domain/enum collision and two direct query operators; other operators and session/search_path combinations remain open.
This evidence does not close B3 or qualify the 0.2.0 release.
